description: This file implements a heartbeat runner for a system, managing scheduled heartbeat tasks, handling heartbeat responses, session management, and integrating with external plugins and configurations. It includes functions to run a heartbeat cycle once, start a continuous heartbeat runner, and manage heartbeat scheduling and deduplication.

classes.name: HeartbeatRunner
classes.description: Represents a heartbeat runner with control methods to stop and update configuration.

methods.name: loadHeartbeatRunnerRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the runtime module for heartbeat runner.

methods.name: hasExplicitHeartbeatAgents
methods.description: Checks if the configuration explicitly defines heartbeat agents.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatConfig
methods.description: Resolves the heartbeat configuration for a specific agent, considering defaults and overrides.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatAgents
methods.description: Returns a list of heartbeat agents based on configuration, with fallback to default.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatPrompt
methods.description: Generates the prompt message for heartbeat based on configuration and defaults.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatAckMaxChars
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of characters for heartbeat acknowledgment.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatSession
methods.description: Resolves the session details for a heartbeat, including session key and store path.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatReasoningPayloads
methods.description: Filters reply payloads to those starting with 'Reasoning:'.

methods.name: restoreHeartbeatUpdatedAt
methods.description: Updates the 'updatedAt' timestamp in session store for a heartbeat.

methods.name: pruneHeartbeatTranscript
methods.description: Truncates the heartbeat transcript file to prevent context pollution.

methods.name: captureTranscriptState
methods.description: Captures the current state of the transcript file before a heartbeat run.

methods.name: stripLeadingHeartbeatResponsePrefix
methods.description: Removes a specified prefix from the start of a heartbeat response.

methods.name: normalizeHeartbeatReply
methods.description: Normalizes the reply payload, stripping tokens and prefixes, and determining if it should be skipped.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatReasonFlags
methods.description: Determines flags indicating the reason for a heartbeat based on reason string.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatPreflight
methods.description: Performs preflight checks before executing a heartbeat, including file and event inspections.

methods.name: appendHeartbeatWorkspacePathHint
methods.description: Adds a hint to the prompt about the correct HEARTBEAT.md file path.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatRunPrompt
methods.description: Builds the prompt for the heartbeat run, including handling tasks and pending events.

methods.name: runHeartbeatOnce
methods.description: Executes a single heartbeat cycle, managing session, response, and event emission.

methods.name: startHeartbeatRunner
methods.description: Starts a continuous heartbeat runner with scheduling and session management.
